theorems.name: Submission.dph_lpf_boundary
theorems.statement: (∀ (m m' : ℕ) (G : Eucl m → Eucl m') (Λ : ℝ≥0) (r : ℝ) (F : Set (Eucl m)), 0 < r → IsClosed F → LipschitzOnWith Λ G (thickening r F) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl m'), IsCompact K → IsCompact (G ⁻¹' K ∩ F)) → ∃ Gj : ℕ → Eucl m → Eucl m', (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (Gj n)) ∧ (∀ n, ∀ x ∈ thickening (r / 2) F, ‖fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x‖ ≤ Λ) ∧ TendstoUniformlyOn Gj G atTop (thickening (r / 2) F) ∧ ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ K : Set (Eucl m'), IsCompact K → IsCompact (Gj n ⁻¹' K ∩ F)) → (∀ (m m' k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k) (G : Eucl m → Eucl m') (Λ : ℝ≥0) (r : ℝ), X.mass < ∞ → (∀ (j : ℕ) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) (j + 1)), k = j + 1 → HEq Y X → Y.boundary.mass < ∞) → 0 < r → LipschitzOnWith Λ G (thickening r X.support) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl m'), IsCompact K → IsCompact (G ⁻¹' K ∩ X.support)) → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) k, (∀ (Gj : ℕ → Eucl m → Eucl m') (O : Set (Eucl m)) (L : ℝ), IsOpen O → X.support ⊆ O → (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (Gj n)) → (∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ x ∈ O, ‖fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x‖ ≤ L) → TendstoUniformlyOn Gj G atTop O → ∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) k) (ηj : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k), (∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ N : Set (Eucl m), IsOpen N ∧ X.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, (ηj n : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) k) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') k) (Gj n x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x)) → Tendsto (fun n => X (ηj n)) atTop (𝓝 (S ω))) ∧ (∀ S' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) k, (∀ (Gj : ℕ → Eucl m → Eucl m') (O : Set (Eucl m)) (L : ℝ), IsOpen O → X.support ⊆ O → (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (Gj n)) → (∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ x ∈ O, ‖fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x‖ ≤ L) → TendstoUniformlyOn Gj G atTop O → ∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) k) (ηj : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k), (∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ N : Set (Eucl m), IsOpen N ∧ X.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, (ηj n : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) k) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') k) (Gj n x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x)) → Tendsto (fun n => X (ηj n)) atTop (𝓝 (S' ω))) → S' = S) ∧ S.mass ≤ (Λ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ k * X.mass ∧ S.support ⊆ closure (G '' X.support)) → (∀ (m m' j : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) (j + 1)) (G : Eucl m → Eucl m') (Λ : ℝ≥0) (r : ℝ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) (j + 1)), X.mass < ∞ → X.boundary.mass < ∞ → 0 < r → LipschitzOnWith Λ G (thickening r X.support) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl m'), IsCompact K → IsCompact (G ⁻¹' K ∩ X.support)) → (∀ (Gj : ℕ → Eucl m → Eucl m') (O : Set (Eucl m)) (L : ℝ), IsOpen O → X.support ⊆ O → (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (Gj n)) → (∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ x ∈ O, ‖fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x‖ ≤ L) → TendstoUniformlyOn Gj G atTop O → ∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) (j + 1)) (ηj : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) (j + 1)), (∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ N : Set (Eucl m), IsOpen N ∧ X.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, (ηj n : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) (j + 1)) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') (j + 1)) (Gj n x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x)) → Tendsto (fun n => X (ηj n)) atTop (𝓝 (S ω))) → (∀ (Gj : ℕ → Eucl m → Eucl m') (O : Set (Eucl m)) (L : ℝ), IsOpen O → X.boundary.support ⊆ O → (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (Gj n)) → (∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ x ∈ O, ‖fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x‖ ≤ L) → TendstoUniformlyOn Gj G atTop O → ∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) j) (ηj : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) j), (∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ N : Set (Eucl m), IsOpen N ∧ X.boundary.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, (ηj n : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) j) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') j) (Gj n x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x)) → Tendsto (fun n => X.boundary (ηj n)) atTop (𝓝 (S.boundary ω))))
